title: What an observer of kinematics recovers of the oracle in models of collective leadership: code and results
description: Simulation engine, analysis scripts and archived results of the paper of the same title: how much of the benefit of recognising the informed individual (an oracle) an observer that only sees motion recovers in models of collective leadership, with one or several informed agents, under other noise and agility, and with false alarms; and what zebrafish with trained individuals, jackdaw, tetra, stickleback and homing-pigeon data say about it.
